content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

No most-favoured-nation obligation burdens our side anywhere in the Transfer and Servicing Agreement. Targeted searches for "most favoured/favored nation", "no less favorable", "favorab", "favor", comparable/third-party terms and right-to-match mechanics returned nothing responsive — the only "favor" hits are security-interest grants in favour of the Issuer or Indenture Trustee.

Servicer compensation (Section 3.8, p0134) is a fixed, defined Servicing Fee plus Supplemental and Temporarily Excluded Receivables Servicing Fees, with no requirement that the Issuer or Depositor extend Cellco terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and no obligation to match a third-party offer. Accordingly no redline was proposed.
